anomaly_signals.detail: 150 errors out of 856 spans — ~17.5% error rate. Dominant error source in the entire trace batch, strongly indicative of LLM-layer instability under the rag_meltdown scenario.
35 GenAI token truncation events detected globally, likely concentrated on llm-gemini given its high error rate. Truncated context will degrade RAG response quality.
25 errors out of 500 spans — 5% error rate. Vector retrieval failures are upstream triggers for RAG pipeline degradation and LLM context starvation.
21 GenAI tool failures detected globally, with tool-executor logging 17 errors out of 483 spans (~3.5%). Tool call reliability is significantly impaired.
23 errors out of 474 spans (~4.9% error rate). Agent orchestration is being disrupted, likely cascading from vector-db and llm-gemini failures.
14 errors out of 419 spans (~3.3% error rate). Elevated for a payments path; may indicate downstream propagation from upstream agent/workflow failures.
p99 latency of ~11,976ms (~12s) across the batch is severely elevated. End-users are experiencing near-12s tail latencies, consistent with LLM and vector-db stalls cascading upward.

recommended_action: Immediately investigate llm-gemini and vector-db: circuit-break or throttle LLM requests experiencing truncations/errors, check vector-db index health and query latency, and verify tool-executor retry/fallback configuration. Consider enabling a degraded-mode RAG path (e.g., reduced top-k retrieval or cached embeddings) to stabilise tail latency while the root cause is resolved.
summary: A rag_meltdown scenario is actively degrading the RAG pipeline: llm-gemini is the epicentre with a ~17.5% span error rate, 35 token truncations, and 21 tool failures, while vector-db (5% errors) and agent-service (4.9% errors) are amplifying the cascade. P99 latency has ballooned to ~12 seconds, signalling severe end-to-end user impact.
